title: Remove ActiveJobs launch blockers
summary: Removed ActiveJobs records from launch, close-readiness, shutdown, snapshot, telemetry, repair-reconcile, and autonomy-health blocking decisions. ActiveJobs remains passive diagnostics evidence only.
reason: The operator explicitly rejected the ActiveJobs protection after a failed pipeline ActiveJobs record blocked launch and backend shutdown/readiness. Changelog review found the blocking behavior was added as the 2026-05-08 ActiveJobs Close-Readiness Guard and hardened on 2026-05-09; earlier 2026-05-06/2026-05-07 changes created and reconciled the contract.
behavior_before: Non-terminal or malformed ActiveJobs records could block pipeline launch, shell close-readiness, backend shutdown, autonomy health, snapshot freshness, telemetry process guard rows, and startup repair-reconcile status. Operator-facing WebView and repair guidance also described ActiveJobs as blocking or process-lifecycle evidence.
behavior_after: ActiveJobs records are read-only passive diagnostics. Launch and shutdown blockers now come from real related processes, fresh progress, pending publish, final-library promotion, queue source scan, schedule-stop watcher, and other non-ActiveJobs gates. ActiveJobs stale/malformed/active rows no longer block launch, close-readiness, backend shutdown, autonomy health, snapshot activity, telemetry health, or startup repair-reconcile overall status.
tests_added: Updated close-readiness, launch, shutdown, rename, autonomy-health, ActiveJobs status, snapshot runner, repair-reconcile, and WebView diagnostics tests to assert ActiveJobs no longer blocks lifecycle decisions.
Kept real process and fresh progress blocking coverage so the remaining active-work protections are not accidentally removed.

Added a browser-backed Launch page smoke that clicks the actual Start / Launch button, allows /api/pipeline/start, verifies an OK pipeline.start backend response, and confirms the dummy service recorded started_pipeline without touching media files.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m py_compile touched Python source files - passed

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --changed - passed; existing dirty worktree caused unrelated generated-summary warnings/diffs outside this packet.
rollback_plan: Restore ActiveJobs close-block helper APIs and their callers in process guard, lifecycle, active job runner, telemetry, snapshot runner, autonomy health, startup repair-reconcile, and WebView guidance; restore the PowerShell active_jobs_ignore_pids handoff; revert the focused tests and generated summaries; then rerun the same validation. Rollback only changes lifecycle policy code and diagnostics text, not media files or runtime ActiveJobs state.
notes: Historical changelog review: ActiveJobs contract hardening landed 2026-05-06; runtime reconciliation landed 2026-05-07; the launch/close-readiness blocking behavior was added 2026-05-08 as ActiveJobs Close-Readiness Guard and hardened 2026-05-09 for PID reuse. This change deliberately leaves ActiveJobs record persistence and read-only diagnostics available, but removes them from lifecycle blocking policy.
